recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Grenada. Parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a commonwealth realm.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor General Cecile LA GRENADE (since 7 May 2013); Prime Minister Dickon MITCHELL (since 24 June 2022)
government: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
economy: small OECS service-based economy; large tourism, construction, transportation, and education sectors; major spice exporter; shrinking but still high public debt; vulnerable to hurricanes; emerging blue economy incentives GDP (PPP): $2.08 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; the Royal Grenada Police Force (under the Ministry of National Security) includes a Coast Guard and a paramilitary Special Services Unit (2025)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
